episodes.187096: Moist and unstable air along a stalled frontal boundary over South Florida led to the formation of slow-moving showers and thunderstorms during the evening hours of November 14th.

events.narrative: Standing water and stranded vehicles were reported along several streets in Pompano Beach and Oakland Park due to heavy rainfall after continuous rounds of showers and thunderstorms moved across the area. Up to 6 inches of standing water was reported along portions of State Road A1A with multiple stranded vehicles. 4 to 6 inches of rain was estimated to have fallen within a 3-hour period across this area.
